title: Conduct security control testing: decision comparison 1
teachingQuestion: Which test safely produces evidence for the control/failure claim?
focalInsight: Select technique from claim, attack path, safety, scope, and evidence.
caption: Compare meaning, decision conditions, and failures. These concise distinctions are paired with the worked examples in the teaching unit.
altSummary: Select technique from claim, attack path, safety, scope, and evidence.
textFallback:
control testing: test control objective. Decision: define expected behavior. Failure/example: deployment only
